name: Separate Diffuse/Reflection Bias
aliases: Independent Bias for Diffuse and Reflection Cones
definition: A parameter separation technique where the single cone tracing bias value is split into two independent parameters: `bias` for diffuse cones and `reflection_bias` for the single specular/reflection cone. This allows independent tuning because reflections benefit from a smaller bias for sharp contact reflections, while diffuse GI benefits from a larger bias to reduce self-occlusion noise.
